Note: বিভিন্ন pronoun এর উদাহরণ দেখে নাও:

Personal- I, We, You, He etc.

Interrogative- Who, What, Which etc.

Distributive- Each, Neither, Either, Everybody, Everyone etc.

Demonstrative- This, That, These, Such etc.

Relative- Who, Which, That, What, But, As etc.

Reciprocal- Each other, One another etc.

eflexive and Emphatic- Myself, Himself, Herself, Yourself etc.

Indefinite- One, Any, Some, Other, Many, Few etc.
